user.title: E-Ink Calendar
user.description: Choose the calendars to show. Weather comes from NOAA for your Home Assistant home location (US only).

data_description.waste_calendar: Events on this calendar become bin icons. Summaries containing 'recycl' get the recycling icon, 'yard' / 'green waste' / 'compost' the leaf.
data_description.quiet_start: Set start and end to the same time to disable quiet hours.
data_description.weather_redraw_hours: Calendar changes always republish right away; forecast tweaks wait this long to save battery.

tags.title: Calendar tags
tags.description: Optional 1-3 character tag drawn in a black chip before each event, e.g. K, S, FAM. Leave blank for none.

finish.title: Display credentials
finish.description:
Put these in your ESPHome secrets.yaml, then flash the firmware from the repository's esphome folder.

**eink_device_id:** `{device_id}`

**eink_token:** `{token}`

The display calls `{path}`. The token is also shown later under this integration's Configure button.
